text:
[LGRA.12.8.1] Inside a rule or schema body, if the first statement is a
bare string literal (single or triple-quoted), it's the
docstring. Subsequent strings are not treated as
docstrings; they're part of the rule body (which for
rules means they'd need to be part of a larger
expression / action — a bare string alone in the middle
of a rule body is a compile error).
